children: Concrete Pumping Holdings reported third-quarter FY2026 results with revenue of $116.8M, up 12.6% from $103.7M a year earlier, and diluted EPS of $0.09 versus $0.07 in the prior-year quarter; consolidated net income was $4.93M, up from $3.7M.
Revenue was $116.8M for 3Q FY2026, compared with $103.7M in the year‑ago quarter; YoY change 12.6%.
Net income was $4.93M consolidated for 3Q FY2026, compared with $3.70M in the year‑ago quarter; YoY change 33.3%.
Diluted EPS was $0.09 for 3Q FY2026, compared with $0.07 in the year‑ago quarter.
Total revenue rose 10.6% year-to-date and 12.6% in the quarter, driven by stronger commercial and infrastructure demand.
Growth was led by U.S. concrete pumping and waste management, with increased volumes from data center and infrastructure projects.
U.K. expansion accelerated following the April 2026 acquisition of Templant, which added complementary temporary power services.
Operational efficiency improved in waste management with better labor productivity and stable weather supporting utilization despite fuel and maintenance inflation.
